description: Defines a template class 'ssl_stream' that wraps boost::asio::ssl::stream providing SSL socket functionality with additional properties and integration with boost::beast websocket streams.

classes.name: ssl_stream
classes.description: A C++11 enabled SSL socket wrapper providing an interface similar to boost::asio::ssl::stream with additional properties and WebSocket support hooks.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Returns the executor associated with the SSL stream.

methods.name: native_handle
methods.description: Returns the native handle of the SSL stream.

methods.name: next_layer
methods.description: Accesses the next layer of the stream.

methods.name: lowest_layer
methods.description: Accesses the lowest layer of the stream.

methods.name: set_verify_mode
methods.description: Sets the verification mode for SSL.

methods.name: set_verify_depth
methods.description: Sets the verification depth for SSL.

methods.name: set_verify_callback
methods.description: Sets the verification callback for SSL.

methods.name: async_shutdown
methods.description: Asynchronously shuts down the SSL connection.
